messages:
Alice Chen: Heads-up — getting a high-sev from support: CUST-4523 reporting a big spike of 503s for hosted inference in us-west-2. They say it started ~15:10 UTC and is persistent. They attached a few request IDs and traces.

Raj Patel: looking now. i'm seeing a 12% 503 rate on the /v1/generate route for the model pool 'gpu-pool-a'. p95 latency also jumped from 140ms -> 800ms.

Marco Rivera: can someone paste the worker logs? i’m worried about OOM or segfaults.

Jenna Ortiz: customer says 503s affect their webhook retry logic. they escalated to enterprise-support. ticket INC-7891 opened. customer impact: some failed payments webhooks are being retried.

Li Wei: pulled logs from one of the affected upstream pods. repeated crashloop with messages:
```
[2026-03-15T15:12:03Z] infer-runner[pid:1245] ERROR: runtime exception: CUDA out of memory when allocating 8589934592 bytes
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
Aborted (core dumped)
```
Also one stack shows a segfault in the attention kernel: `./libattn.so(+0x41f2b) [0x7f2c41f2b]`

Raj Patel: yep that matches - GPU OOMs followed by process aborts. looks like a new model variant was rolled into the pool ~14:58 UTC (model: llm-x-16b-qa-quant). deploy-bot shows a canary rollout finished at 14:59.

deploy-bot: canary rollout completed for model llm-x-16b-qa-quant on gpu-pool-a at 2026-03-15T14:59:22Z

Marco Rivera: if the quantized kernel has a memory regression we should rollback ASAP. can we pin the pool back to the previous model version?

infra-oncall: on it. scaling additional nodes won't help if process immediately OOMs — but i'll remove the canary and pin to llm-x-16b-qa-quant@v1 -> rollback to llm-x-16b-qa@v0.

Li Wei: quick mitigation options:
- disable KV prefetch for that model (reduce memory pressure)
- temporarily set max_batch_tokens=512 and batch_size=1 in the batcher config
- force-run inference on 16-bit float fallback if quant kernels failing

Jenna Ortiz: i pushed a message to the customer: "We're investigating — temporary mitigation in progress, will update in 15m."

Alice Chen: infra-oncall — before rollback can you confirm if there are any hot restarts that would cause cascading evictions? we saw container evictions followed by scheduling delays.

infra-oncall: confirmed: kube events show CrashLoopBackOff and then the scheduler tries to reschedule, but the GPU nodes are near capacity which delays recovery and causes a cascade of 503s due to upstream timeouts.

Marco Rivera: can we throttle the rollout traffic to the affected pool (route by model tag) and route new requests to fallback pool with stable model variant? we have routing policy to divert 25% traffic.

Raj Patel: doing a targeted route change now:
```bash
# route requests for model llm-x-16b-qa-quant -> fallback-pool until rollback
redwood route update --model llm-x-16b-qa-quant --to fallback-gpu-pool --weight 100
```

Raj Patel: route updated. monitoring errors.

SRE-Bot: alert resolved? 503 spike is down to 3% after routing.

Jenna Ortiz: customer says they see reduced failures now, but still occasional 500s. forwarding logs to ENG.

Li Wei: we should collect a core dump and GPU memory stats from the failing pod for postmortem. steps:
1) kubectl cp the /var/crash/core from pod if present
2) capture nvidia-smi before restart: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total --format=csv`
3) enable extra logging on attention kernel via env `ATTN_DEBUG=1`

Alice Chen: Marco, can you reproduce on staging with the same quant build and pinned traffic? if we can get a deterministic repro we can file a kernel bug.

Marco Rivera: spinning up a staging job with a long-run load test now. using the same image: `registry.redwood/llm-x-16b-qa-quant:20260315-canary` and playback of customer's request pattern (batch sizes, sequence lengths).

Marco Rivera: initial run shows memory creeping then OOM at ~1400 tokens for sequence length distribution skewed to long prompts. looks like a per-request kv cache overcommit combined with quantized attention workspace.

Li Wei: ok file a bug against the kernel team: KRN-2417. include core, nvidia-smi, runtimes, and the exact prompt payload that repros.

Alice Chen: action items:
- infra-oncall: finish rollback to stable model and confirm all pools healthy (ETA 10m)
- Raj: keep routing to fallback until rollback confirmed (in progress)
- Marco: repro on staging and attach artifacts to KRN-2417
- Jenna: update customer every 15m with progress and ticket link INC-7891

infra-oncall: rollback started. rolling back model on gpu-pool-a -> llm-x-16b-qa@v0. monitoring restarts.

SRE-Bot: rolling-update: patched 8/12 nodes, remaining 4 draining, expected completion 7m

Raj Patel: error rate dropping to baseline 0.9% now. latency p95 back to ~160ms.

Jenna Ortiz: customer updated: "We see steady traffic and errors are decreasing. Thank you" :thumbsup:

Marco Rivera: staging repro artifacts uploaded to bug tracker, attached kernel logs and the prompt corpus. link: https://redwood.internal/bugs/KRN-2417

Li Wei: follow-up items for postmortem:
- add pre-deploy memory smoke tests for quant kernels with long-seq fuzzing
- add guard to prevent canary rollout when node memory headroom < 20%
- improve runtime to fail fast before OOM (reject with 429 or degrade to fallback model)

Alice Chen: agreed. i'll own postmortem doc and timeline. assigning follow-ups in linear.

Jenna Ortiz: closing loop with customer; keeping ticket open until postmortem published.

Alice Chen: nice work triaging quickly. let's sync 30m after rollback completes to draft the postmortem and customer note. :white_check_mark:
